description: Complete exact-peer permission set replacements invalidate affected invite/call/presence/MIMI decisions at actual admission cuts; current revisions never roll back and requester outcomes remain opaque.

decision_points.requirement: Excluded private-contact discovery and PSI cannot be called or advertised and cannot change any index; MIMI identifier commitments cannot produce matches.
The next holder invite delivery re-evaluates current Consent before its durable CAS and never trusts a pre-revoke decision; a refusal remains opaque to the requester.
A signed empty replacement invalidates all derived scope decisions while retaining its exact current revision.
Older reads and exact Event retries never roll back the current Consent revision or reactivate a revoked grant.
Invite requester responses cannot distinguish a revoked Consent from one never granted, including in-flight revocation races.

Valid signed per-holder relation, complete current, exact decrypted Invite and independent membership/capability/focus/device checks succeed at all three current cuts; real token and product are released.
Invite received through ordinary encrypted rail without holder product delivery material cannot ring, push or use invitation token admission.
Changing any holder, full inviter, Call, scope, envelope byte, media, producer signer, audience, subject device or decrypted kind/call/media rejects; digest is not plaintext type evidence.
A granted holder succeeds while a second denied holder never rings or receives a token; neither holder outcome authorizes the other.

Future/expired/unknown-constrained scope entries never authorize; there is no independent record or any fallback. Removing voice preserves other explicitly unchanged entries but invalidates stale voice decisions.

Real holder authority revoke accepted before each product/ring/token cut denies that stage; queued or in-flight old outcomes are never reused; after-cut revoke does not retroactively hang up established participants.

Human fixed-Station rejection and stale/read/retry/window fences. Transferable non-Human PCR handoff is independently specified by authority-commit-fixture handoff_private_manifest.transferable_pcr_runtime and cannot be claimed by this Human case.

Invited first join uses exact relation and fresh token cut; affirmative signed voluntary join is legal; only accepted same actor/device active participant may refresh within accepted media. Unestablished refresh, automatic voluntary fallback and narrower-media expansion reject.

Sender sees identical deferred for absent, revoked, denied, queued or delivered holders; authority/material recovery permits fresh legal retry and all three cuts succeed without durable Consent duplication.

cases.name: excluded_private_discovery_and_psi_remain_unavailable
cases.given: current-v1 offers only public Realm metadata discovery, and a peer has active or revoked Consent
cases.action: inspect advertised operations, attempt excluded discovery and PSI paths, and query the registered MIMI identifier facade
cases.observed: operation availability, MIMI match fields and index state
assertions: excluded discovery and PSI operations cannot be called or advertised
the attempts change no index and never invoke a PSI rotation
the authenticated MIMI facade returns matched=false without peer identity or handoff material for every commitment

cases.name: cached_invite_gate_is_reevaluated_before_the_next_submission
cases.given: an active Consent permitted a holder invite delivery preflight
cases.action: commit a matching revoke before the private delivery CAS, then retry the delivery
cases.observed: the holder delivery state and opaque requester response
assertions: no stale preflight authorizes the holder-private delivery CAS
the gate uses current Consent under the same holder PCR lock as Replace
the requester receives opaque deferred without a consent_revoked reason

cases.name: empty_replacement_clears_every_scope_cache
cases.given: All four concrete entries exist in one exact-peer current and caches bind its revision.
cases.action: Accept a holder-signed empty complete replacement using that exact current revision.
cases.observed: All registered admission gates after the replacement.
assertions: All four scopes deny; no independent any or record can keep an omitted scope active.
Empty remains present with its accepted revision; replay of an older Event never installs it again.
Presence consent_only: every recipient must have a current eligible presence entry; suppress the entire encrypted scope if any fails.

cases.name: older_reads_and_exact_retries_never_rollback_current_revision
cases.given: a grant was accepted and then revoked at a later holder PCR Commit
cases.action: replay the exact replacement Events and deliver an older cached current read
cases.observed: historical retry outcomes and the subsequent authoritative current read
assertions: exact retries return their original accepted outcome without a new Commit
the current Consent remains revoked at the revoke revision
older cached reads cannot override a known revoke or authorize any consumer

cases.name: revocation_is_not_distinguishable_from_never_matching
cases.given: one peer had Consent revoked and another never received Consent
cases.action: attempt equivalent invite deliveries, including one preflight that races the revoke
cases.observed: the external response shape and timing for both peers
assertions: both requester responses have the same opaque deferred shape and disclosure class
consent_revoked is an internal authorization outcome and MUST NOT be the reason the requester sees
timing does not separate the two

Human governance change, freeze/export/import/acceptance/activation and separated-governor proxy/publication reject with zero Event, Commit, head, generation, private state or notification effects even with complete archives and both service signatures.

Foreign-current-authority verdicts, stale or expired outstanding outcomes never release product/ring/token. Valid same-Station key/endpoint updates do not advance governance_generation; every new release independently rechecks the actual current authorization and exact request window.
Fresh authorized requests at the owning Station recover legal product/ring/token delivery, durable local publication and account-subscribe catch-up without repeating the private CAS or fanout.

Durable roster join and leave use the exact complete ActorId and real DeviceId from the authenticated token request. Accounts sharing principal_id but differing in station_id remain distinct. Scalar anonymous DID, roster_identity, subject_binding and subject_binding_digest are not accepted wire carriers.

Established refresh names participant_id and independently matches the current accepted full actor/device, Realm/Call/focus and signed actual media range. Missing participant, wrong Station/device/participant/focus, revoked permissions, stale leg after kick/leave, terminal Call and media expansion reject. A new voluntary join after kick remains possible under current admission. Accepted historical issuer signatures remain verifiable after restart or rotation without accepting an uncommitted old binding.
